blocks.htmlEn: Our paint shop also renewed the entire finish to the client’s wishes, here in fish silver metallic and deep black, including authentic hand-painted coachlines.

blocks.htmlEn: Finally, our upholstery shop will fit a completely new interior in fine genuine leather and a made-to-measure convertible hood.

descriptionEn: Our paint shop also renewed the entire finish to the client’s wishes, here in fish silver metallic and deep black, including authentic hand-painted coachlines.
